observations: Photo 0 shows a standing gas cooker with 4 burners (4-face layout).
Stainless/metal top with burner caps and control knobs visible.
The cooker appears wrapped in plastic/covering around the body.
No clear brand/model name is readable in the photo.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a cooker that looks clean, but refurbishment level (parts replaced, restoration quality) is not verifiable remotely.
Photo 0 does not show it being tested/ignited; working condition cannot be confirmed from a still image.

risks.risk: Burners may not ignite properly (or may ignite unevenly) even if the cooker looks clean.
risks.proof: A short video clip of lighting all 4 burners (including low flame) and showing stable blue flames for 30–60 seconds.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (use the lowest comparable as worst-case).

risks.risk: Missing/weak parts (burner caps, knobs, regulator/hose) or damaged ignition components.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each burner cap seated correctly, all knobs, and the gas inlet/regulator connection area (plus what accessories are included).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst-case within the comparable range).

risks.risk: Oven/grill (if present) may not heat or may have faulty thermostat/igniter.
risks.proof: Video of oven ignition/heating (door closed) or a photo of the oven interior with a working test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as oven performance unproven (assume only burners are reliable).

risks.risk: Potential gas leaks or poor sealing around the top/oven door.
risks.proof: A leak test proof (soap-bubble test video at connections) or a technician test receipt.

proof_requests: Video: light all 4 burners and show stable flames (low + high) for 30–60 seconds.
Photos: close-ups of burner caps, all knobs, and the gas inlet/regulator connection; list included accessories (hose/regulator).
If it has an oven: video of oven ignition/heating and how long it takes to heat.
Leak test: short clip showing soap-bubble check at all connections.
response.reason: The photo clearly shows a 4-burner standing gas cooker, but brand/model and working/refurbished status are not fully verifiable; pricing is therefore matched to the cheapest comparable as worst-case.
